def factor_tail_asymmetric_vol_ratio(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    logret = np.log(df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(1))
    downside_sq = np.where(logret < 0, logret**2, 0.0)
    upside_sq = np.where(logret > 0, logret**2, 0.0)
    downs = pd.Series(downside_sq, index=df_copy.index).rolling(60, min_periods=20).mean()
    ups = pd.Series(upside_sq, index=df_copy.index).rolling(60, min_periods=20).mean()
    asym = (downs - ups) / (downs + ups).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return asym.rename("factor_tail_asymmetric_vol_ratio")
description: Measures realized tail asymmetry as the rolling 60-day average of squared negative log returns minus squared positive log returns, normalized by total squared variation. A positive ratio means downside variance dominates upside variance, indicating stress accumulation and asymmetric downside risk. This captures path-based tail exposure beyond drawdown depth.
